## Types

### ColourSpec

One or two colour codes (doc 03 §3.4).

Type: array of [`ColourCode`](#colourcode) (at least 1 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### ColourCode

An IEC 60757 or profile-declared company colour code, or {"foreign": code} (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Ident`](#ident)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `foreign`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `foreign` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

### Csa

A cross-section: a Dec3 string in mm², {"awg": n} or {"kcmil": Dec3} (doc 08 §4.6).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Dec3`](#dec3)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `awg`: integer (min -128, max 127) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `awg` | integer (min -128, max 127) | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**

   Shape: object { `kcmil`: [`Dec3`](#dec3) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `kcmil` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader. |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
